products.name: Synology DiskStation DS220+
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-bay drive enclosure, Intel Celeron J4025 dual-core, 2GB DDR4 ECC RAM (expandable to 6GB).
strengths: DSM software is the most polished NAS interface available, Plex, photo backup, and file sync apps are well-integrated
Transcoding support handles 4K video playback without client-side processing
Drive compatibility list is extensive, most major NAS-optimized hard drives are verified
limitations: Diskless, drives sold separately (add the cost of two WD Red or Seagate IronWolf drives)
